problems_fixed.old: Speed = distance / time = 5 km / 20 min = 0.25 km/min. Read the distance at 20 minutes (5 km) and divide by the time.
problems_fixed.new: It looks like you inverted the formula. Speed = distance / time, not time / distance. At 20 minutes the distance is 5 km, so speed = 5 / 20 = 0.25 km/min.
